edges.reason: Owned constructor sets owner = msg.sender, so the deployer captures full privileges
confirmOwner requires candidate == msg.sender before promoting the caller to owner
onlyOwner modifier gates changeOwner on owner == msg.sender
freeze(address,bool) is restricted by onlyOwner comparing owner to msg.sender
freeze(bool) is restricted by onlyOwnerOrBackend using msg.sender
transferToToken is restricted by onlyOwnerOrBackend using msg.sender
transferFromFund checks msg.sender against owner, cryptaurRewards or backend
changeAddress requires msg.sender == cryptaurRecovery
deposit is restricted by onlyBackend comparing backend to msg.sender
withdraw is gated by notFreezed reading freezed[msg.sender]
notFreezed modifier reads freezed[msg.sender] to authorize the caller
setUnlimitedMode resolves the master wallet from msg.sender
pay2 resolves the dapp wallet from msg.sender
pay resolves the buyer wallet from msg.sender
payDAPP treats msg.sender as the pulling dapp and credits balances[msg.sender]
shareBalance resolves the master wallet from msg.sender
setBackend writes the backend address that later authorizes msg.sender
_owner parameter is stored into candidate
_masterWallet selects the master dictionary in linkToMasterWalletInternal
_linkedWallet is pushed into the slave list and reverse map
_old selects the branch and dictionary inside applyChangeWalletAddress
_new is validated and written as the replacement wallet
_who is resolved to a master wallet and credited on deposit
_amount is added to the credited balance via add()
_txHash is emitted in the Deposit event alongside the credit
_amount bounds the withdrawal and is subtracted via sub()
_buyer balance is debited and forwarded to the rewards call
_seller balance is credited with _amount minus fee
_opinionLeader is forwarded to the external rewards payment call
_freeze is written into the freezed mapping for the target wallet
_backend becomes the privileged backend address via setBackend
_cryptaurRecovery gains the right to move balances via changeAddress
_cryptaurToken replaces the externally called token contract
_cryptaurRewards replaces the external contract that computes fees
_cryptaurReserveFund replaces the external reserve contract and payout key
_addresses array drives the privileged balance drain loop
_to receives funds moved out of the reserve fund balance
_dapp receives the allowance written into available
_newMaxCount changes the linked wallet cap enforced on all users
_unlimited selects the stored UnlimitedMode for the dapp
transferToToken calls the mutable external token contract inside a loop after zeroing balances
withdraw performs an external ERC20 transfer call that can reenter the depository
payInternal calls CryptaurRewards.payment before the buyer/seller balances are settled
payInternal calls the reserve fund depositNotification after crediting fee
payDAPP calls CryptaurRewards.payment before deducting the buyer balance
payDAPP calls reserve fund depositNotification during settlement
transferFromFund calls withdrawNotification on the reserve fund contract
payInternal computes _amount - fee with raw unchecked subtraction
payDAPP computes _amount - fee with raw unchecked subtraction
payDAPP decrements the available mapping with raw -=, bypassing sub() and underflow checks
payDAPP increments balances[cryptaurReserveFund] with raw +=, bypassing add() and overflow checks
cryptaurRewards address decides whether the external payment callback happens in payInternal
cryptaurReserveFund address is both fee sink and external notification target
payInternal reads and writes the balances mapping for buyer, seller and reserve fund
payDAPP mutates the available allowance mapping with raw arithmetic
payDAPP branches on unlimitedMode to decide allowance update
deposit re-checks freezed[masterWallet] in addition to the notFreezed modifier
freezedAll short-circuits every notFreezed guarded entry point including deposit
cryptaurToken state variable provides the callee address of the external transfer
setCryptaurToken lets the owner repoint the contract that receives transfers
deposit calls getOrAddMasterWallet to resolve the credited wallet
withdraw calls getMasterWallet to resolve the caller's wallet
pay2 delegates settlement to the externally calling payInternal
pay delegates settlement to the externally calling payInternal
payDAPP calls balanceOf2Internal to verify spendable allowance
changeAddress delegates address book rewiring to applyChangeWalletAddress
masterWallet local is the balance key credited in deposit
dapp local is the caller resolved inside pay2
seller local is passed to payInternal by pay2
buyer local is passed to payInternal by pay
buyerMasterWallet local keys both balance and allowance updates in payDAPP
fee local returned by the rewards contract drives seller and reserve credits
amount local holds the per-address balance drained by transferToToken
index local controls the transferToToken iteration bounds
avail local is the return value computed by balanceOf2Internal

normalization_plan.reason: _owner only carries the new candidate value into changeOwner
_masterWallet only selects the dictionary used by linkToMasterWalletInternal
_linkedWallet only carries the slave key written by linkToMasterWalletInternal
_old only selects the update path inside applyChangeWalletAddress
_new only supplies the replacement address handled by applyChangeWalletAddress
_wallet only carries the lookup key consumed by getMasterWallet
_who only selects the wallet credited by deposit
_amount only supplies the credited value processed by deposit
_txHash only supplies the event field emitted by deposit
_buyer only carries the debited account into payInternal
_seller only carries the credited account into payInternal
_opinionLeader only forwards an argument to the external rewards call in payInternal
_freeze only carries the flag written by freeze(address,bool)
_backend only supplies the privileged address written by setBackend
_cryptaurRecovery only supplies the privileged address written by setCryptaurRecovery
_cryptaurToken only supplies the callee address written by setCryptaurToken
_cryptaurRewards only supplies the external contract address written by setCryptaurRewards
_cryptaurReserveFund only supplies the external contract address written by setCryptaurReserveFund
_addresses only provides the iteration source of transferToToken
_to only carries the recipient handled by transferFromFund
_dapp only supplies the allowance key written by shareBalance
_newMaxCount only supplies the cap written by setMaxLinkedWalletCount
_unlimited only selects the enum value written by setUnlimitedMode
masterWallet is a transient resolution detail of deposit balance accounting
dapp is a transient resolution detail of pay2
seller is a transient resolution detail of pay2
buyer is a transient resolution detail of pay
buyerMasterWallet is a transient resolution detail of payDAPP
fee is a transient result of the external rewards call inside payInternal
amount is a transient per-iteration balance read in transferToToken
index is the loop counter of transferToToken
avail is the transient return accumulator of balanceOf2Internal
